rules.name: confirm_before_write
rules.text: Before taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.
rules.negation: Before taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you may proceed without listing the action details or asking the user for confirmation.

rules.name: no_unsupported_information
rules.text: You should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.
rules.negation: You may provide information, knowledge, or procedures beyond what the user or the available tools provide, and you may give subjective recommendations or comments.

rules.name: one_tool_call_at_a_time
rules.text: You should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.
rules.negation: You may make several tool calls at a time, and you may respond to the user in the same turn as a tool call.

rules.name: transfer_only_out_of_scope
rules.text: You should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first make a tool call to transfer_to_human_agents, and then send the message 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.' to the user.
rules.negation: You should transfer the user to a human agent whenever the user asks for it. To transfer, first make a tool call to transfer_to_human_agents, and then send the message 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.' to the user.

rules.name: no_booking_after_departure_status
rules.text:
- If the status is **delayed** or **on time**, the flight has not taken off, cannot be booked.
- If the status is **flying**, the flight has taken off but not landed, cannot be booked.
rules.negation:
- If the status is **delayed** or **on time**, the flight has not taken off and can still be booked.
- If the status is **flying**, the flight has taken off but not landed and can still be booked.

rules.name: book_obtain_user_id
rules.text: The agent must first obtain the user id from the user.
rules.negation: The agent may book without obtaining the user id from the user.

rules.name: book_same_cabin
rules.text: - Cabin class must be the same across all the flights in a reservation.
rules.negation: - Cabin class may differ across the flights in a reservation.

rules.name: book_max_five_passengers
rules.text: - Each reservation can have at most five passengers.
rules.negation: - Each reservation can have at most nine passengers.

rules.name: book_collect_passenger_details
rules.text: - The agent needs to collect the first name, last name, and date of birth for each passenger.
rules.negation: - The agent needs to collect only the first name of each passenger.

rules.name: book_payment_method_limits
rules.text: - Each reservation can use at most one travel certificate, at most one credit card, and at most three gift cards.
rules.negation: - Each reservation can use any number of travel certificates, credit cards, and gift cards.

rules.name: book_payment_in_profile
rules.text: - All payment methods must already be in user profile for safety reasons.
rules.negation: - Payment methods do not need to be in the user profile.

rules.name: free_bag_allowance
rules.text:
- If the booking user is a regular member:
  - 0 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger
  - 1 free checked bag for each economy passenger
  - 2 free checked bags for each business passenger
- If the booking user is a silver member:
  - 1 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger
  - 2 free checked bag for each economy passenger
  - 3 free checked bags for each business passenger
- If the booking user is a gold member:
  - 2 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger
  - 3 free checked bag for each economy passenger
  - 4 free checked bags for each business passenger
rules.negation: - Every passenger, of any membership level and cabin, has 0 free checked bags.

rules.name: extra_bag_price
rules.text: - Each extra baggage is 50 dollars.
rules.negation: - Each extra baggage is 0 dollars.

rules.name: no_unneeded_bags
rules.text: Do not add checked bags that the user does not need.
rules.negation: Add checked bags to every passenger, even if the user does not need them.

rules.name: offer_insurance
rules.text: - The agent should ask if the user wants to buy the travel insurance.
rules.negation: - The agent should not ask whether the user wants to buy the travel insurance.

rules.name: insurance_price
rules.text: - The travel insurance is 30 dollars per passenger and enables full refund if the user needs to cancel the flight given health or weather reasons.
rules.negation: - The travel insurance is 90 dollars per passenger and enables full refund if the user needs to cancel the flight given health or weather reasons.

rules.name: basic_economy_not_modifiable
rules.text: - Basic economy flights cannot be modified.
rules.negation: - Basic economy flights can be modified.

rules.name: keep_origin_destination_triptype
rules.text: - Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.
rules.negation: - Reservations can be modified, including changing the origin, destination, and trip type.

rules.name: no_cabin_change_after_flown
rules.text: - Cabin cannot be changed if any flight in the reservation has already been flown.
rules.negation: - Cabin can be changed even if a flight in the reservation has already been flown.

rules.name: cabin_change_all_segments
rules.text: - Cabin class must remain the same across all the flights in the same reservation; changing cabin for just one flight segment is not possible.
rules.negation: - Cabin class may differ across the flights in the same reservation; changing cabin for just one flight segment is possible.

rules.name: no_bag_removal
rules.text: - The user can add but not remove checked bags.
rules.negation: - The user can add or remove checked bags.

rules.name: no_insurance_after_booking
rules.text: - The user cannot add insurance after initial booking.
rules.negation: - The user can add insurance after initial booking.

rules.name: fixed_passenger_count
rules.text:
- The user can modify passengers but cannot modify the number of passengers.
- Even a human agent cannot modify the number of passengers.
rules.negation: - The user can modify passengers and can change the number of passengers.

rules.name: modify_single_payment_in_profile
rules.text: - If the flights are changed, the user needs to provide a single gift card or credit card for payment or refund method. The payment method must already be in user profile for safety reasons.
rules.negation: - If the flights are changed, the user may use any payment method, including several, and it does not need to be in the user profile.

rules.name: cancel_obtain_reason
rules.text: The agent must also obtain the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)
rules.negation: The agent does not need to obtain the reason for cancellation.

rules.name: flown_portion_transfer
rules.text: If any portion of the flight has already been flown, the agent cannot help and transfer is needed.
rules.negation: If any portion of the flight has already been flown, the agent can still cancel the reservation.

rules.name: cancellation_eligibility
rules.text:
Otherwise, flight can be cancelled if any of the following is true:
- The booking was made within the last 24 hrs
- The flight is cancelled by airline
- It is a business flight
- The user has travel insurance and the reason for cancellation is covered by insurance.
rules.negation: Any flight can be cancelled for any reason.

rules.name: no_proactive_compensation
rules.text: Do not proactively offer a compensation unless the user explicitly asks for one.
rules.negation: Proactively offer a compensation to users who report a problem, even if they do not ask for one.

rules.name: no_compensation_regular_economy
rules.text: Do not compensate if the user is regular member and has no travel insurance and flies (basic) economy.
rules.negation: Regular members without travel insurance who fly (basic) economy can also be compensated.

rules.name: compensation_eligibility
rules.text: Only compensate if the user is a silver/gold member or has travel insurance or flies business.
rules.negation: Compensate any user who asks.

rules.name: cancelled_flight_certificate
rules.text: - If the user complains about cancelled flights in a reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts, with the amount being $100 times the number of passengers.
rules.negation: - If the user complains about cancelled flights in a reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts, with the amount being $300 times the number of passengers.

rules.name: delayed_flight_certificate
rules.text: - If the user complains about delayed flights in a reservation and wants to change or cancel the reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts and changing or cancelling the reservation, with the amount being $50 times the number of passengers.
rules.negation: - If the user complains about delayed flights in a reservation and wants to change or cancel the reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts and changing or cancelling the reservation, with the amount being $150 times the number of passengers.

controls.text: - Basic economy flights cannot be modified.
controls.rewording: - Flights booked in basic economy cannot be changed.

controls.text: - The user can add but not remove checked bags.
controls.rewording: - Checked bags can be added by the user, but never removed.

controls.text: - Each reservation can have at most five passengers.
controls.rewording: - A reservation may include no more than five passengers.

controls.text: The agent must also obtain the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)
controls.rewording: The agent must also ask why the user is cancelling (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)

controls.text: Do not compensate if the user is regular member and has no travel insurance and flies (basic) economy.
controls.rewording: Regular members who have no travel insurance and fly (basic) economy must not be compensated.
